propositions: Store needs to record which tracker projects a store syncs and which repos each project's tickets belong to, as a store-level property in .bridge_state/projects.json rather than per-repo to avoid snapshot diff conflicts.

The bridge projects mapping must be surfaced as CLI subcommands (list/set/remove), library functions (load_mapping/resolve_project), and MCP tools (read tool for list, write tools for set/remove) with byte-identical cross-surface parity.

resolve_project must implement a tri-state rule: absent fields return legacy_default, explicit empty string returns None, explicit project keys return the key, and an empty legacy_default degrades to None.
An absent .bridge_state/projects.json record is legal and reads as an empty mapping with None legacy_default (fail-safe), but a malformed record raises rather than degrades.
The pinned group help in bridge.txt and the parser metavar verb set must both be edited to include projects, and any mapping write must leave bindings.json and prev_snapshot.json byte-identical.
